segmente.text: In marketing, everyone knows the 4P model.
But branding works on a different model.
The only P branding is about is perception.
And perception is the sum of every impression people get from your business.
The way your product looks, the way your message sounds,
the way your brand makes them feel.
It's not the price or the product itself that matters at all.
It's the meaning people attach to each and every interaction with you.
This is why in branding, perception becomes reality.
